scientific_limitations: The count is proved only for integer bases g>=4, the alternating even/odd partition, two unordered positive summands, and strict cutoffs g^(2k). Comparisons do not rule out every implicit earlier derivation; independent validation has not been performed.
title: Exact nonuniqueness counts for even–odd \(g\)-adic bases in every base \(g\ge4\)
